FCN.title: Practical 1
FCN.description: Study Cisco Packet Tracer basics, OSI and TCP/IP network models, and fundamental transmission media concepts including cable types, communication modes, bandwidth, delay, and multiplexing.

FCN.title: Practical 2
FCN.description: Develop experiential understanding of basic computer network communication by configuring two-PC connectivity, observing IP addressing, MAC addressing, ARP and ICMP packet flow, and analyzing TCP/IP protocol header fields using Cisco Packet Tracer, Wireshark and basic networking commands.

FCN.title: Practical 3
FCN.description: Develop experiential understanding of Layer-2 communication by implementing Ethernet raw-socket programs, analyzing hub and switch behavior, observing ARP and MAC-address tables, and designing and troubleshooting a multi-switch LAN using Linux and Cisco Packet Tracer.

FCN.title: Practical 4
FCN.description: Develop experiential understanding of Layer-3 communication by configuring interconnected networks, analyzing router forwarding decisions, routing tables, default gateways, ARP operation and TTL changes, and implementing static routing using Cisco Packet Tracer and Linux-based packet observation.

FCN.title: Practical 5
FCN.description: Design and evaluate a multi-branch enterprise network using RIP version 2 dynamic routing and centralized DHCP services. Analyze route advertisement, routing-table updates, DHCP relay operation, DHCP DORA packet exchange, packet forwarding, Layer-2 and Layer-3 address changes, traceroute behavior, and alternate-route selection after introducing a failover link using Cisco Packet Tracer.

FCN.title: Practical 6
FCN.description: Simulate a star topology with a central router and 5 hosts. Measure average delay and packet loss while sending UDP traffic using OnOffApplication.

FCN.title: Practical 7
FCN.description: Simulate two transport protocols (TCP and UDP) over a dumbbell topology. Compare throughput, jitter, and fairness.

FCN.title: Practical 8
FCN.description: Simulate a chain topology with 4 nodes. Apply QoS parameters (priority queue) and analyze delay variation for different traffic types (voice vs data).

FCN.title: Practical 9
FCN.description: Create a wireless network using WiFi Helper in NS-3. Simulate AODV and DSDV routing protocols and evaluate packet delivery ratio (PDR) and routing overhead.

FCN.title: Practical 10
FCN.description: Text Message Echo and Processing over TCP and UDP Socket Communication

FCN.title: Practical 11
FCN.description: File Transfer over TCP Sockets in C++

FCN.title: Practical 12
FCN.description: Multi-Client Chat Server using TCP and Threads in C++

FCN.title: Practical 13
FCN.description: ICMP Ping Utility Using Raw Sockets in C++

FCN.title: Practical 14
FCN.description: Analyze and interpret live packet data captured using Wireshark. Identify packet structure, protocols used, and basic troubleshooting through headers
